name: Wenge Huang
abstract_title: A DYNAMIC SELF-MODEL TO RECONCILE HIGHER-ORDER AND REFLEXIVE THEORIES: BRIDGING THE ONTOLOGICAL-PHENOMENOLOGICAL GAP
abstract: Consciousness studies face a long-standing debate between Higher-Order Theories (a mental state becomes conscious via a separate Higher-Order Representation) and Reflexive Theories (consciousness is an intrinsic, built-in property of experience itself), a stalemate which has hindered progress in understanding the nature of self-awareness. field: Philosophy of consciousness, Buddhist phenomenology, higher-order theories
notable: Developed Dynamic Self-Model reconciling Higher-Order and Reflexive theories
notes: Bridges Theravada Buddhist meditation insights with Western consciousness studies.
